description_en: Queries the list of detection processes by calling ListDetectProcesses

kebab_example: aliyun idrsservice list-detect-processes --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --name '检测流程名称' --publish-status true --type LOCAL --sort desc --sort-key CONTENT --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDetectProcesses
